_README: Errata licence register — Phase 1 C2 census input (audit-charter § 7). Decomposed from protocol-errata.md by two Opus 5 agents (2026-07-29), quotes mechanically verified verbatim (44 whitespace-only re-anchorings applied to the E31-E61 half; no paraphrase found).

entries.title: Stale version/date in OSF companion README
entries.impact: None (cosmetic)

licences.description: Corrects a stale date (2026-01-14) in the OSF companion README to 2026-01-31, aligning version metadata across the three OSF companion documents; no protocol content changed.
licences.quote: These are companion metadata files, not the preregistration document itself.

entries.title: Missing execution fields in Phase 1 config
entries.impact: Would have prevented execution or produced non-preregistered results

licences.description: Adds five missing execution fields to the Phase 1 library config so the batch script runs at the preregistered parameter values rather than crashing or silently using script defaults (notably temperature 0.1 instead of 1.0).
licences.quote: Added the five fields to `library_pure-positive-canon.json`, matching the values specified in the preregistration (Section 8.9) and the pattern established in other detection configs (e.g., `detect_image-only.json`).

entries.title: SDK migration for Gemini ThinkingConfig support
entries.impact: Would have prevented all detections (100% failure rate)

licences.description: Migrates the batch detection script from the deprecated google-generativeai SDK (v0.8.6) to google-genai (v1.56.0) so that ThinkingConfig, and hence the registered thinking-level factor, is supported at all.
licences.quote: Migrated to the `google-genai` SDK (v1.56.0) which supports `types.ThinkingConfig` natively.

licences.description: Licenses substitution of the API-available model endpoint gemini-3-flash-preview wherever the preregistration names gemini-3-flash, via a name-resolution mapping; treated as the same model.
licences.quote: the preregistered model name `gemini-3-flash` does not exist as an API endpoint — the current API name is `gemini-3-flash-preview`. Added model name resolution logic to map the preregistered name to the API-available variant.

entries.title: Tile bounds generation Y-axis inversion
entries.impact: Evaluation reported near-zero F1 due to misscoped references

licences.description: Fixes a Y-axis inversion in tile bounds generation (metadata[1] is minY, not maxY) that shifted every tile ~2565 m south, plus GeoJSON property naming; calibration bounds regenerated.
licences.quote: Corrected the metadata interpretation (`metadata[1]` is `minY`), fixed property names, and regenerated `calibration_bounds.geojson` from the current calibration manifest.

entries.title: Evaluation pipeline reference path and column name bugs
entries.impact: Evaluation silently returned no references, reporting near-zero metrics

licences.description: Fixes three evaluation-infrastructure bugs: reference directory path (inputs/vectors/references/), source_tiles list vs source_tile string, and the same path bug in analyse_study_effects.py.
licences.quote: These are implementation bugs in evaluation infrastructure; the preregistered evaluation methodology is unchanged.

entries.title: Pipeline contract validation (post-Phase 1 hardening)
entries.impact: Prevents recurrence of E4-E5 silent failures in Phase 2+

licences.description: Adds three categories of contract validation (loud reference-loading failure, bounds metadata spot-check, seven pipeline-contract integration tests) so stage-boundary bugs fail loudly rather than silently in Phase 2 onwards.
licences.quote: These are infrastructure hardening measures that do not change the preregistered methodology.

entries.title: Evaluation reference scoping hardened against boundary effects
entries.impact: Preventive — no change to Phase 1 calibration metrics; prevents latent bug from manifesting in denser tile configurations (Phase 2+)

licences.description: Replaces union_all() reference scoping with per-tile sjoin at three sites and scopes references unbuffered before applying the 20 m match buffer; Phase 1 metrics unchanged.
licences.quote: Extracted a shared helper function `scope_references_to_tiles()` using `gpd.sjoin()` with `predicate='intersects'` against individual tile polygons, replacing all three `union_all()` sites.

licences.description: Licenses an expanded default spatial-tolerance sweep, adding a 40 m level for the two-dimensional failure ranking framework.
licences.quote: the `spatial_tolerance_curve()` default buffer list was updated from `[10, 20, 30, 50]` to `[10, 20, 30, 40, 50]` to include the 40m tolerance level used in the two-dimensional failure ranking framework.

entries.title: Hard example crops extracted from full map GeoTIFFs
entries.impact: Crops may include map content from outside the detection tile boundary

licences.description: Licenses extracting all hard-example crops from the full map GeoTIFFs, centred on the target coordinate, rather than from the 512x512 detection tiles as the preregistration implicitly assumed; crops may therefore cross tile boundaries.
licences.quote: all hard example crops (both hard positives and hard negatives) were extracted as 128×128 pixel regions from the full map GeoTIFFs (`inputs/rasters/*.tif`), not from the 512×512 detection tiles.

licences.description: Fixes the unregistered hard-example crop size at 128x128 px and flags crop size as a future exploratory (OFAT) variable.
licences.quote: Crop size is flagged as a future exploratory variable (64, 128, 256, 512px OFAT experiment).

entries.title: Centre-pointing language added to detection prompts
entries.impact: Adds instructional text not specified in preregistration

licences.description: Licenses adding a centre-pointing sentence to the preamble of all 11 detection system instructions, applied uniformly across H5 levels so that factor orthogonality is preserved.
licences.quote: The sentence is applied uniformly across all H5 conditions (Minimal, Terse, Verbose) to preserve factor orthogonality — centre-pointing is spatial orientation, distinct from H5's diagnostic text treatment.

entries.title: 50m recognition/localisation threshold — post-hoc narrowing of the registered HP definition (reclassified 2026-07-28)
entries.impact: Determines which FNs qualify as hard positive candidates

licences.description: Licenses a post-hoc recognition/localisation distinction with a 50 m boundary applied to false negatives when selecting hard positives — an addition the registered FN-mining definition does not contain.
licences.quote: The recognition/localisation distinction and its threshold are post-hoc additions

licences.description: Records the consequence of the narrowing: the registered hard-positive pool shrinks to 4, cascading into the E11, E12, and E13 deferrals; E51 later re-mined 108 HP under a v2 definition.
licences.quote: this deviation **narrows the registered HP pool** — restricting HP selection to recognition failures reduced the pool to 4, which cascaded into E11 (Scale-16/32 deferred), E12 (H9 image diversity reduced to HN-only), and E13 (H12 deferred).

entries.title: Scale-16 and Scale-32 library conditions capped
entries.impact: H8 conditions 6–7 deferred; scaling contrasts S2 and S3 deferred to post-H10

licences.description: Licenses NOT executing the Scale-16 and Scale-32 library conditions (H8 conditions 6-7): both configs are marked deferred with empty example arrays, and scaling contrasts S2 and S3 are postponed to post-H10.
licences.quote: Both config files are marked `"status": "deferred"` with empty example arrays. H8 contrasts C1–C3, S1, and B1 remain fully testable. Scaling contrasts S2 and S3 are deferred to post-H10 (calibration tile expansion).

licences.description: Frames the deferral as activation of a preregistered contingency path (capping at the maximum available HP/HN while preserving the 1:1 ratio) rather than a deviation.
licences.quote: If fewer than 16 distinct HPs or HNs are available, Scale-32 (and possibly Scale-16) will be capped at the maximum available while preserving 1:1 ratio.

entries.title: H9 image diversity runs as HN-diversity-only (HP frozen)
entries.impact: H9-C tests HN rotation only; HP diversity is untestable

licences.description: Licenses running H9-C (image diversity) as hard-negative rotation only, with the hard-positive channel frozen across passes; the HP-diversity half of the registered factor is not executed and is deferred to post-H10.
licences.quote: Due to HP pool exhaustion (E11), the HP channel is frozen: 4 slots, 4 examples, every HP appears in every pass. Only HN examples rotate across passes. HP diversity is untestable with the current pool.

entries.title: H12 (HP:HN ratio) deferred to post-H10
entries.impact: Exploratory hypothesis H12 postponed

licences.description: Licenses NOT executing H12 (HP:HN ratio) at this point: with HP capped at 4 the only feasible ratios confound ratio with total library size, so the hypothesis is postponed until the HP pool expands after H10.
licences.quote: Deferring to post-H10 preserves the possibility of an informative, symmetric test.

entries.title: Verbose instruction word count exceeds preregistered range
entries.impact: Minor — verbose M/E level ~80 words above target

licences.description: Licenses a verbose-level instruction text of 779 words — roughly 80 words above the preregistered brief-to-verbose range — as a conservative deviation that if anything amplifies the H1 M/E effect.
licences.quote: Iterative prompt refinement across Sessions 12–14 (decision procedure restructuring, centre-pointing language, exclusion criteria updates) has grown the verbose-level instruction text to 779 words. The brief-to-verbose ratio is now approximately 1:3.7 (213:779), which exceeds the preregistered range by ~80 words.

entries.title: Inconsistent pass count references in preregistration appendix
entries.impact: None (internal inconsistency in submitted preregistration; execution used the correct value)

licences.description: Records two stale "≥3/10" pass-count references in the preregistration appendix (HP selection, HN TBD table) as residual draft text superseded by the operative ≥3/5 procedure.
licences.quote: The stale "≥3/10" references are residual from an earlier draft and do not reflect intended methodology.

licences.description: Confirms Phase 1 baseline calibration executed at K=5 passes, the value specified by the operative appendix procedure; the threshold is moot because all 24 FNs were complete misses.
licences.quote: Phase 1 was executed with K=5 passes as specified by the operative procedure.

entries.title: Prompt text shifted from cartographic naming to visual descriptions
entries.impact: Changes wording of preregistered prompt text without altering prompt structure or factor design

licences.description: Licenses rewording exclusion categories and feature descriptions in all 10 detection instructions from cartographic identity names to visual appearance descriptions, applied uniformly across H5 conditions; structure, factor design, and example library unchanged.
licences.quote: these were systematically revised to use visual appearance descriptions

entries.title: Execution plan and Phase 2 YAMLs contained erroneous N=5 passes multiplier
entries.impact: Would have run 5× more API calls than preregistered, at 5× the cost

licences.description: Removes the erroneous within-run passes: 5 multiplier from all five Phase 2 study YAMLs and the execution-plan cost formulas, restoring the registered K=10 independent single-pass design and flat run_{run}/ output paths.
licences.quote: Removed the `passes` field from all five Phase 2 YAML files.

licences.description: Confirms H3 voting is tested post-hoc by re-pooling the same K=10 single-pass runs (N=5 from runs 1-5, N=10 from all runs) rather than by additional API calls.
licences.quote: voting analysis (H3) is performed post-hoc by re-pooling the same K=10 single-pass runs (N=5 from runs 1–5, N=10 from all runs) without additional API calls.

entries.title: Config naming convention clarification (§8.7.4 _minimal suffix)
entries.impact: None (naming simplification only)

licences.description: Clarifies that the unsuffixed detect_*.json configs are the H5=Minimal variants referenced in §8.7.4 as detect_*_minimal.json; only non-default H5 levels carry _terse/_verbose suffixes.
licences.quote: This is a naming simplification: the unsuffixed config IS the H5=Minimal variant.

entries.title: Validation bounds generated from wrong manifest
entries.impact: Evaluation reported F1 ~0.1 instead of ~0.4 for sanity check runs

licences.description: Regenerates validation_bounds.geojson from validation_manifest.json (60 tiles) after it had been built from the calibration set; corrects sanity-check F1 from ~0.08-0.11 to 0.360-0.435.
licences.quote: Regenerated `validation_bounds.geojson` from `validation_manifest.json` using the `create_bounds_geojson()` function, producing 60 tile features matching the validation manifest.

entries.title: Standardised "holdout" → "validation" naming across codebase
entries.impact: None (internal naming only)

licences.description: Licenses the codebase using "validation" where the preregistration §2.1 says "holdout" for the 60-tile evaluation set; the 281-tile reserve keeps the holdout sense. Naming only, tile sets unchanged.
licences.quote: The tile sets are unchanged; only internal naming is standardised.

entries.title: Stale `passes` parameter in analysis script
entries.impact: Would have caused analysis to look for non-existent pass subdirectories

licences.description: Removes the vestigial passes=5 parameter and pass-subdirectory traversal from the Phase 2 analysis loader, and fixes detection-file globbing for extensionless outputs.
licences.quote: Removed `passes` parameter. Rewrote file discovery to iterate `run_*` directories directly and glob `detections_*` files with explicit exclusion of `.meta.json`, `_fp.*`, and `_fn.*` files.

entries.title: Per-run evaluation architecture (was merged, now per-run)
entries.impact: Previous merged approach would have produced nonsensical precision values

licences.description: Licenses computing F1/precision/recall per run rather than on all K=10 runs merged, with per_run_metrics.csv as the intermediate artefact and two new multi-run bootstrap functions for the repeated-measures structure.
licences.quote: Rewrote evaluation to compute F1 per run independently

licences.description: Records the corrected attribution for the tile-level bootstrap resampling unit: fixed pre-lodgement in Decision 10, not specified by registered §3.5, which states only that 95% bootstrapped CIs will be used.
licences.quote: This preserves the tile as the resampling unit (fixed pre-lodgement in Decision 10, `decisions-log.md:337`; the registered §3.5 specifies only "95% bootstrapped CIs" — attribution corrected 2026-07-28, D17 audit U1)

entries.title: Enhanced API metadata capture (citation, prompt block reason, prompt safety)
entries.impact: Three Gemini API fields were silently discarded; now captured

licences.description: Captures three previously discarded Gemini API metadata fields (citation metadata, prompt block reason value, prompt-level safety ratings) into LLMResponseMetadata and thence .meta.json.
licences.quote: This captures additional API-provided metadata for transparency. The detection methodology is unchanged.

licences.description: Records that the three image-only runs completed before the fix permanently lack these metadata fields; all subsequent runs carry them.
licences.quote: The 3 existing image-only runs (completed before this fix) lack these fields. This is unavoidable as the data cannot be recovered retroactively. All subsequent runs capture them.

entries.title: Dry-run checkpoint corruption bug in run_phase2.py
entries.impact: Dry runs corrupted checkpoint state, preventing correct resume

licences.description: Guards checkpoint writes behind if not dry_run so that --dry-run no longer marks execution units complete; the corrupted checkpoint (3 -> 50 units) was manually restored before data collection resumed.
licences.quote: Wrapped checkpoint updates in an `if not dry_run:` guard so that dry runs never modify the persistent checkpoint state.

entries.title: Modality manipulation not implemented — text-only conditions received images
entries.impact: 20 runs (brief-text × 10, verbose-text × 10) tested wrong modality; must be re-run

licences.description: Adds the include_example_images config field and the conditional skip in the batch script so that the registered text-only H1 levels actually receive no example images; brief-text and verbose-text configs set it false.
licences.quote: The batch detection script (`4_detect_mounds_batch.py`) unconditionally loaded and sent all 17 example images from the config's `examples` array to the API, regardless of condition. No conditional logic existed to skip images for text-only conditions. All 5 conditions received identical image content.

licences.description: Scopes re-execution to the two text-only conditions (20 runs, 1,200 calls, ~$2.60) and rules the pre-fix data invalid for the H1 modality question while retaining secondary value; the three image-using conditions stand.
licences.quote: Only brief-text and verbose-text conditions (20 runs) require re-execution. The other 3 conditions (image-only, brief-text-image, verbose-text-image) correctly received images and are valid.

entries.title: Bootstrap CI bias from reference de-duplication on resampled tiles
entries.impact: Bootstrap CIs were systematically deflated; point estimates unaffected

licences.description: Refactors all seven bootstrap functions to pre-compute per-tile TP/FP/FN and aggregate with duplicates handled, removing the reference de-duplication that deflated CIs (e.g. point F1 0.4252 vs CI [0.254, 0.373]); point estimates were never affected.
licences.quote: Per-run F1 point estimates (in `per_run_metrics.csv`) were always correct — they use `calculate_f1_internal()` which does not resample tiles. Only the bootstrap CIs were biased.

licences.description: Licenses per-tile rather than per-map spatial matching inside the bootstrap as an approximation, on the grounds that cross-tile matches within the 20 m buffer are negligible at these tile sizes.
licences.quote: The fix uses per-tile matching rather than per-map matching (as `calculate_f1_internal()` does). Cross-tile matches within the 20 m buffer are negligible given tile sizes (hundreds of metres).

entries.title: Dual-track carry-forward from Phase 2a (OFAT deviation)
entries.impact: Phases 2b–2e carry two M/E levels instead of one; text-only track skips 2c, defers 2d/2e

licences.description: Licenses carrying two M/E levels forward from Phase 2a instead of the single optimum the registered OFAT design specifies: brief-text-image on the full 2b-2e chain and brief-text on a targeted track, each with independent optimal parameters.
licences.quote: The preregistered OFAT design (§8.3.1a) specifies selecting a single optimal M/E level from Phase 2a and carrying it forward through all subsequent phases.

licences.description: Licenses NOT executing Phase 2c for the text-only track and deferring Phases 2d and 2e for it, on the grounds that those phases are structurally incompatible with a text-only winner; any text-only results from deferred phases are exploratory.
licences.quote: **brief-text** (Track 2): receives targeted tests — Phase 2b temperature testing; Phase 2c skipped; Phases 2d and 2e deferred pending results

entries.title: H5 instruction text adapted for Phase 2d (HN image references removed, OFAT simplification)
entries.impact: Changes wording of preregistered instruction text; simplifies Phase 2d design

licences.description: Licenses trimming Guideline 3 (and the verbose exclusion intro) in the terse and verbose instruction files because the hard-negative images they referenced were dropped once Phase 2c selected plus-hp; the minimal instruction is deliberately left unmodified, accepting a minor confound rather than re-running 1,200 calls.
licences.quote: Guideline 3 in terse and verbose instruction files was trimmed from two sentences to one

licences.description: Licenses NOT executing the preregistered 3x3 (M/E x H5) factorial for Phase 2d, replacing it with single-factor OFAT at the carried-forward optimal M/E per track: 3 cells (1 reused, 2 new) per track; M/E x H5 interactions become untestable.

factors.design: 3 H5 levels x 1 M/E level per track

licences.quote: The preregistered 3×3 factorial (3 M/E levels × 3 H5 levels) is replaced by single-factor OFAT testing H5 at the carried-forward optimal M/E level per track.

licences.description: Activates the text-only Track 2 for Phase 2d, which E27/Decision 16 had deferred, because precision is the bottleneck in both modalities.
licences.quote: Track 2 (text-only brief-text) was deferred for Phase 2d in Decision 16 but is now activated.

entries.title: `reorder_examples()` canonical-first was a no-op
entries.impact: All prior phases used config-file order unknowingly; no results affected

licences.description: Records that canonical-first ordering was a no-op returning config-file order [C+, HP, C-, null], so Phases 2a-2d all ran the config-default ordering; no prior results are invalidated because the flag was never set.
licences.quote: All prior phases (2a–2d) used the default ordering from the config file, which is what they were intended to use — the `canonical-first` flag was never explicitly set in those phases.

licences.description: Splits the ordering factor into an explicit config-default no-op and a true canonical-first grouping, and implements canonical-last and random with exhaustive category filtering, so H4 can be tested with genuinely distinct levels.

factors.example_ordering: config-default, canonical-first ([C+, C−, HP, null]), canonical-last, random

licences.quote: Explicit no-op returning examples in JSON config-file order (the ordering all prior phases actually used)

entries.title: Phase 2e tests 4 ordering conditions instead of preregistered 3
entries.impact: Adds 1 condition (10 runs, 600 API calls) to Phase 2e

licences.description: Licenses a fourth Phase 2e ordering condition beyond the three in the execution plan, adding config-default as an explicit baseline distinct from true canonical-first.
licences.quote: The execution plan (§Phase 2e) specifies 3 ordering conditions: canonical-first, canonical-last, and random. Phase 2e now tests 4 conditions by adding `config-default` as an explicit baseline distinct from `canonical-first`.

licences.description: Licenses satisfying the added config-default condition by symlink reuse of the Phase 2c plus-hp outputs (10 pre-checkpointed units) rather than new API calls; units rise 30 -> 40 with no net cost increase.
licences.quote: The `config-default` baseline is reused from Phase 2c plus-hp outputs via symlinks, adding no additional API cost for those 10 runs.

entries.title: Deterministic runs at T=0.0 copied instead of re-executed

licences.description: Licenses copying detection outputs from an already-completed replicate instead of re-executing against the API, for the 4 remaining deterministic (T=0.0, fixed-ordering) Phase 2e units. Field table is a bullet list (Date/Phase/Type/Severity: Low) with no Impact row.
licences.quote: For 4 remaining deterministic units (canonical-first/run\_1, canonical-last/run\_3, canonical-last/run\_6, canonical-last/run\_8), detection outputs were copied from an existing completed run in the same condition rather than re-executing against the API.

licences.description: Licenses treating copied replicates as equivalent to executed ones in bootstrap analysis; deterministic conditions legitimately show zero within-condition variance.
licences.quote: Bootstrap CIs for deterministic conditions will show zero within-condition variance regardless of whether runs were executed or copied.

entries.title: Phase 3a uses T=0.3/T=0.7 instead of carry-forward T=0.0

licences.description: Licenses running Phase 3a consensus voting at T=0.3 and T=0.7 in place of the registered carry-forward T=0.0, because consensus voting is meaningless on identical (deterministic) runs. Field table is a bullet list (Date/Phase/Type/Severity: Low) with no Impact row.
licences.quote: Phase 3a tests consensus voting at T=0.3 and T=0.7 instead of the carry-forward T=0.0.

licences.description: Licenses evaluating consensus voting against the T=0.0 single-run baseline rather than against a same-temperature single-run baseline.
licences.quote: The consensus voting comparison is against the T=0.0 single-run baseline, not against single-run performance at the same temperature.

entries.title: Verifier crop extraction reads from tiles instead of source rasters
entries.impact: Mounds near tile edges receive asymmetrically truncated crops, potentially biasing verifier decisions

licences.description: Code fix: crops are now extracted from the parent GeoTIFF with boundless reads so every crop is exactly padding*2 square, rather than being clamped at tile boundaries.
licences.quote: Modified both scripts to resolve each detection's `source_tile` to its parent GeoTIFF raster (in `inputs/rasters/`), then extract the crop with `boundless=True`.

licences.description: Licenses (indeed mandates) re-running all affected Phase 3d proposer-verifier experiments with corrected crop extraction, with the pre-fix results archived rather than deleted.
licences.quote: All affected verifier experiments to be re-run with corrected crop extraction. Original results archived to `archive/phase3d-pre-e33/` for comparison.

entries.title: Thinking-level not propagated through batch/subprocess execution units
entries.impact: `--thinking-level` CLI override silently dropped when running via `run_phase2.py`

licences.description: Pure code fix: thinking_level is now copied into execution-unit dicts and a --thinking-level flag added to the detect script and batch library. Caught before any affected data was collected, so no protocol licence attaches.

factors.thinking_level: propagated from condition to execution unit

licences.quote:
The fix was applied
before any replication data was collected, so no results are affected.

entries.title: Bootstrap per-tile matching caused recall bias from reference double-counting
entries.impact: Bootstrap CIs for all prior phases had a small recall bias (bootstrap mean ~7 pp below point estimate at 340 tiles)

licences.description: Code fix: per-tile Hungarian matching inside the bootstrap replaced by per-map matching with TP/FP/FN then distributed to tiles, eliminating reference double-counting across the 64-px tile overlap.
licences.quote:
Rewrote `compute_per_tile_tp_fp_fn()` to match **per map**
(identical to `calculate_f1_internal`), then distribute TP/FP/FN to
tiles: TPs and FPs assigned to the detection's `source_tile`,
unmatched FNs assigned to the reference's primary tile (nearest
centroid via `_assign_refs_to_primary_tiles()`).

licences.description: Licenses fixing the spatial-matching granularity within each bootstrap iteration (per-map, not per-tile) as an unregistered but methodologically consistent analysis choice; the registration constrains only the CI method, not the matching granularity.
licences.quote:
Neither
specifies the spatial
matching granularity (per-tile vs per-map) within each bootstrap
iteration. The correction aligns the bootstrap matching with the
point-estimate matching method, which is the methodologically
consistent choice.

entries.title: 340-tile production retest replaces 60-tile holdout evaluation
entries.impact: All Phase 2–3 results re-evaluated on larger corpus; statistical power substantially increased

licences.description: Licenses replacing the registered 60-tile holdout evaluation with a 340-tile corpus and re-running all Phase 2a–3a conditions from scratch on it.
licences.quote: The evaluation corpus was expanded to 340 tiles (569 ground truth mounds across 4 map sheets) to achieve adequate statistical power. All Phase 2a–3a conditions were re-run from scratch on the full corpus.

licences.description: Licenses reducing replicate count K from the registered 10 to 1–3 for single-pass conditions (retaining K=30 for consensus voting) — registered replicates deliberately not executed.
licences.quote: K was reduced from 10 to 1–3 for single-pass conditions (340 tiles provide sufficient power) and retained at K=30 for consensus voting.

licences.description: Licenses treating 340-tile results as superseding the 60-tile holdout results for all conditions, with the 60-tile results retained as historical reference.
licences.quote: Results from the 340-tile corpus supersede the 60-tile holdout results for all conditions.

entries.title: Proposer-Verifier (PV) pipeline — production implementation of registered H2 Condition B (corrected 2026-07-28)
entries.impact: Reclassifies the headline PV result from "unregistered post-hoc extension" to **confirmatory H2 outcome: the registered null prediction is falsified and the registered stopping rule fired**

licences.description: CORRECTION BLOCK PRESENT (dated Withdrawal, 2026-07-28): the entry's original opening sentence, original Impact line and original Protocol-impact claim are withdrawn as false. PV is registered as H2 Condition B; the headline PV result is reclassified as a confirmatory H2 outcome, not an unregistered extension.
licences.quote:
The preregistration registers the
coarse-to-fine proposer-verifier architecture as H2 Condition B

licences.description: Licenses reporting the production PV programme as the exercised registered contingency: the registered H2 null is falsified and the registered 0.05-F1 stopping rule fired, which is what licensed further pursuit of two-stage architectures.
licences.quote:
The production PV programme is that registered
contingency, exercised.

licences.description: Elaboration 1 — licenses feeding the verifier from a consensus union of proposer passes instead of the registered single liberal Stage-1 detection pass.
licences.quote:
the registered Stage 1 is a single liberal
   detection pass; production feeds the verifier from a consensus union of
   passes.

licences.description: Elaboration 2 — licenses applying the verifier as a binary accept/reject verdict (prob_threshold null) in the headline pipeline, instead of the registered direct use of raw mound_probability scores.
licences.quote:
**Binary application of the verifier verdict** in the headline pipeline
   (`prob_threshold = null`, E56) versus the registered direct use of raw
   `mound_probability` scores (`preregistration-appendix-prompts.md:1584`).

licences.description: Elaboration 3 — licenses the adversarial verifier prompt framing in place of the registered neutral-classifier verifier prompt.
licences.quote:
**Adversarial prompt framing** — the registered verifier prompt is a
   neutral classifier; E39 establishes strategy choice is not load-bearing.

licences.description: Elaboration 4 — licenses the project's crop-extraction geometry, on which the registration is silent (cross-reference E8).
licences.quote: **Crop geometry** — the registration is silent on crop extraction (E8).

licences.description: Elaboration 5 — licenses the choice of verifier consensus size (N=1 vs N=5), on which the registration is silent; tested and found insensitive.
licences.quote:
**Verifier consensus size** — the registration is silent; N=1 vs N=5 was
   tested and found insensitive (Obs 166, 167, 169).

entries.title: Dual-mode API architecture (batch and real-time)
entries.impact: Technical implementation choice; no effect on results

licences.description: Licenses executing any PV run in either Gemini Batch API or real-time mode interchangeably; mode affects only speed, cost and quota, not prompts or results.
licences.quote: Both modes produce identical prompts and results — the mode affects only execution speed, cost (Batch API is 50% cheaper), and quota management.

entries.title: Verifier strategy equivalence confirmed at production scale
entries.impact: Adversarial verifier selected as default; all three strategies produce equivalent F1

licences.description: Licenses retaining the adversarial verifier strategy as the production default, on the finding that adversarial, checklist and brief are statistically indistinguishable at 340-tile scale.
licences.quote: The adversarial strategy was retained as the default for consistency with the pilot and because its adversarial framing provides the most interpretable rejection reasoning.

licences.description: Licenses treating verifier strategy as a non-load-bearing factor in reporting PV results (robustness finding, so results need not be replicated across strategies).
licences.quote: The choice of verifier strategy is not load-bearing for the PV results.

entries.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro requires MEDIUM thinking — deviation from §8.2/§8.9
entries.impact: Pro results use MEDIUM or HIGH thinking instead of preregistered MINIMAL

licences.description: Licenses running Gemini 3.1 Pro at MEDIUM thinking (single-pass) and HIGH thinking (consensus) instead of the preregistered MINIMAL, because the model does not support MINIMAL — registered Pro-at-MINIMAL cells are therefore not executable.
licences.quote: Single-pass Pro experiments use MEDIUM thinking; consensus Pro experiments use HIGH thinking (motivated by the post-registration finding that HIGH thinking benefits consensus voting at strict thresholds, Obs 183).
